Worth knowing

Try it yourself
with
OpenClaw
Copy prompt
Research suppliers for [product type] that ship to [country], and compare them on price, minimum order, shipping time and reviews in a table. Then draft product listings and suggested pricing for my top [number] picks, plus reply templates for common customer questions. Stop once I have the table and drafts, and do not contact suppliers or publish anything without showing me first.
Original source: https://blink.new/blog/openclaw-for-ecommerce-shopify-automation-2026
